title: Apple 2024 Mac mini Desktop Computer with M4 chip with 10-core CPU and 10-core GPU: 16GB, 512GB SSD
writeup: This Apple Mac mini with the M4 chip (10-core CPU, 10-core GPU, 16GB memory, 512GB SSD) is a compact desktop for everyday work, photo and video editing and quiet home-server use. Jeff Geerling measured about 4.1W idle at the wall and about 36W during a Geekbench 6 multi-core run on an M4 mini, with scores near 3,678 single-core and 14,678 multi-core. Price is $699.97. Memory and storage are fixed at purchase, and the power button sits on the bottom.
